development: All thrombin_water/results.zip dry native pools, 12 compounds, three receivers and two seeds. Only 3D49 chain H water 2006 is transferred with the established pocket C-alpha alignment.
held_out_for_this_mechanism: All paired_crossdocking native cross-docking pools for ESR1, PPARG and PDE4D, both archived budgets, no query-deposit waters. These are previously published benchmarks. Redocking is excluded.
held_out_site_rule: Inside the original 24 A receiver docking box, occupancy >= 0.5, positive isotropic B, chain A, accepted altloc blank or A, >=2 protein N/O atoms at 2.4-3.5 A, no protein heavy atom closer than 2.3 A or metal closer than 3 A. One observation gives the historical p=0.75 for each site.
primary: Dry vs point steric exclusion vs Gaussian translation with protein steric exclusion and per-site normalization. Same historical exclusion ramp 2.0-2.6 A for protein and ligand. Temperature 298.15 K. One-axis variance B/(8*pi*pi). Independent site factors. No refit by target, seed or case.
quadrature: Cartesian product Gauss-Hermite order 11 per dimension; order 17 sensitivity.
endpoints: Top-1, top-5, pool oracle at 2 A and conditional top-1. Unique median-gap threefold-separated thrombin ITC pairs, Spearman and Kendall at each receiver/seed. Report all cells, including zero-site receivers.
